parameters.query: SELECT 'attendance' AS data_type, course_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status='present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS present_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='absent'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='late'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status='present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),1) AS rate FROM attendance GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY course_id

SELECT 'submission' AS data_type, task_id, task_name, COUNT(*) AS total_submissions, SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count FROM task_submissions GROUP BY task_id, task_name ORDER BY task_id
